anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.
AI system is not generating any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which suggests it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform and may indicate a halt in trading activities.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it's correctly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Evaluate the trading strategies and system to ensure they are functioning correctly and not inadvertently paused or disabled.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause of the bottleneck.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to degraded system performance, affecting trading operations and user experience.
